name: Dojo for WooCommerce
author: dojopayments

sections.description:
The Dojo plugin for WooCommerce allows you to take payments via Dojo’s secure Online Checkout.

Key Features:
* Checkout Blocks Support: Fully compatible with WooCommerce block-based checkout.
* Classic Support:Backwards compatibility for the classic [woocommerce_checkout] shortcode.
* Secure: Uses Dojo’s secure payment form, reducing your PCI compliance burden.
* HPOS Compatible: Fully compatible with High-Performance Order Storage.

We are here if you have any questions. Please email devsupport@dojo.tech

Support

Questions? Contact us at devsupport@dojo.tech
sections.installation:
Instructional Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0kagHLoYx0w
Dojo Docs Site: https://docs.dojo.tech/plugins/woocommerce

  1. Login to the admin area of your WordPress website.
  2. Go to Plugins -> Add New.
  3. Search for Dojo.
  4. Click Install Now and then Activate.

Step 1: How to generate your API key
1. Log into the Dojo developer portal.
2. Select API keys in the sidebar and click Create new key.
3. Copy the key and paste it into the Secret API key field in the Dojo settings in WordPress (WooCommerce > Settings > Payments > Dojo).

Step 2: How to generate your Webhook endpoint
1. In the Dojo Developer portal, select Webhooks from the sidebar and click Add endpoint.
2. Endpoint URL: Enter your website’s URL followed by /?wc-api=wc_dojo (e.g., https://yoursite.com/?wc-api=wc_dojo).
3. Click Select events and check Status update. Click Add events.
4. Click Add endpoint.
5. On the webhooks page, click the Secret value to copy it.
6. Paste this value into the Webhook secret field in your WordPress Dojo settings and click Save changes.
